title: Intwasahlobo Ephantsi Kwentlabathi
intro: Kwimbali yeQuran, umntu owayenomonde omkhulu wajongana novavanyo olwaluza kwaphula iintliziyo eziqinileyo. Yonke into yahluthwa - ubutyebi, usapho, nempilo. Kodwa ke, ngenxa yokuphelelwa lithemba, umthandazo othobekileyo waphendulwa ngendlela engalindelekanga. Ungawubona lo mphefumlo obali lakhe lokubuyiselwa lihlala linkenteza iminyaka?
clues: Ndavavanywa ngovavanyo olunzima kangangokuba luhlala lukhunjulwa kuyo yonke iminyaka.
Ndilahlekelwe yiyo yonke into ebalulekileyo - ubutyebi bam, abantwana bam, nempilo yam.
Umzimba wam wawugcwele izilonda ezibuhlungu, kwaye ndandingafunwa ngumntu wonke.
Ndiphelelwe lithemba, ndabiza uAllah, ndisithi uSathana undichukumisile ngobunzima nentuthumbo.
U-Allah wandiphendula waza wandiyalela ukuba ndibethe umhlaba ngonyawo lwam.
Kuloo ndawo kanye, kwaphuma umthombo obandayo, waza u-Allah wabuyisela usapho lwam waza waluphinda kabini njengenceba.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
